note: Setup, not a frame. The page is served without the operator token and asks for it once; this hands it over the way the prompt does -- into the tab's sessionStorage, never a URL -- and reloads, so the startup requests carry it. The wait is for an agent row, which only an accepted token can fetch: a wrong one fails the capture here rather than as a timeout steps later.
js: sessionStorage.setItem('raccoon_token', '{{TOKEN}}'); window.__raccoonReloading = true; setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 0); true

note: Setup, not a frame. The connect toasts sit over the top right of every panel that follows, and the side panel's 420px default renders a process list as an unreadable column -- widening it is something an operator does too, the panel has a resizer.
js: document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(e => e.remove()); const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.side-panel{width:62% !important;max-width:62% !important}'; document.head.appendChild(st); true
